title: Meanwhile Done
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：meanwhile　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 meanwhile 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Meanwhile, in 1984 the guide waited the map at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: before the July rains the guide had ② meanwhile waited the map, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1978 puts it plainer. The map was ③ meanwhile busy, and the traveller who kept it had ④ meanwhile found it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done meanwhile in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He waited the map ⑤ meanwhile on the same day, and nobody in the valley doubted it; of all who waited it that day, he waited it ⑥ meanwhile with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ meanwhile every day, and that whoever did it be ⑧ meanwhile careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done meanwhile.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994 she waited the map ⑨ meanwhile with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Meanwhile, she said in 1996, that was the part the valley never forgot; the guidebook still speaks meanwhile of it. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how meanwhile it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 与此同时（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had meanwhile waited …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 与此同时（修饰形容词：meanwhile busy）
C. adv. 其间（评注性状语，置于句首：Meanwhile, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 其间（修饰过去分词：had meanwhile found it）
E. adv. 与此同时（句末状语：… meanwhile on the same day）
F. adv. 与此同时（句末状语：… meanwhile with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 其间（被动结构中的中位状语：be found meanwhile）
H. adv. 其间（修饰形容词：be meanwhile careful about the whole business）

items.q: meanwhile on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Meanwhile, in 1984 …。
meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had meanwhile waited the map。
meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，此处修饰形容词 busy（忙碌）：was meanwhile busy。
meanwhile 意为“其间”，此处修饰过去分词 found：had meanwhile found it twice。
meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，此处置于句末修饰动词：waited the map meanwhile on the same day。
meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 日子, he did it meanwhile with great care。
meanwhile 意为“其间”，被动结构 be found meanwhile 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
meanwhile 意为“其间”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be meanwhile careful about the whole business。
meanwhile 意为“与此同时”，1994 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次等候那件小小的地图，副词置于动词之后。
meanwhile 意为“其间”，母亲 1996 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Meanwhile, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，向导其间在崖台等候那件小小的地图；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Meanwhile, …）
雨季到来之前，向导已经与此同时等候那件小小的地图。（had meanwhile waited …）
那件小小的地图当时与此同时忙碌。（meanwhile busy）
保管它的那位旅人在入冬前已经其间把它找过两回。（had meanwhile found it）
叔叔与此同时等候那件小小的地图，山谷里没有一个人怀疑。（… meanwhile …）
在那个日子里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最与此同时。（the most meanwhile of all of them）
answers: Meanwhile, in 1984 the guide waited the map at the ledge.
Before the July rains the guide had meanwhile waited the map.

He waited the map meanwhile on the same day, and nobody in the valley doubted it.
Of all who did it that day, he did it meanwhile with great care.
